svg.title: Environments: the Deploy Waits at the Gate
svg.desc: A merged change deploys to staging automatically, then the production job waits for an approved reviewer, the wait timer and a main-only branch rule before production secrets unlock and the deploy runs.
svg.text: Environments: the Deploy Waits at the Gate
Rules and secrets apply only to jobs that declare environment: production.
Skips every rule; can't read its secrets
